company.name: Feathery
company.shortDescription: Feathery is an agentic data intake platform that automates operational workflows for financial services companies.
company.description: Feathery develops an AI-powered platform that helps financial services organizations automate data collection, document processing, and operational workflows. The platform supports processes such as client onboarding, risk assessment, account opening, underwriting, and policy analysis while integrating with customer relationship management systems, policy management platforms, custodians, and other business applications. It includes tools for extracting and structuring information from documents, generating forms and business documents, and managing workflow automation across multiple systems. Feathery also provides decisioning capabilities that analyze operational data to support workflow execution and improve data consistency across connected systems. Its platform is used by insurance and wealth management organizations to streamline information intake, reduce manual processing, and manage business operations more efficiently.
